article.story: MALIBU, Calif. -- — Narit Chotikavanic led Stephen F. Austin with 22 points, including the game-winning 3-pointer with one second remaining, and the Lumberjacks took down Pepperdine 63-60 on Friday. Chotikavanic added five steals for the Lumberjacks (5-1). Lateef Patrick added 11 points. Keon Thompson finished with 10 points. Aaron Clark finished with 30 points for the Waves (3-3). Danilo Dozic added 11 points for Pepperdine. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
